text: Recent-cursor event pages now come directly from the bounded ControlState cache with no writer semaphore or disk scan. Older cursors use an unlocked size-snapshot replay; only a transient truncated tail retries under the writer semaphore, and a tail still truncated there is corruption. Added deterministic instrumentation tests over a 256-record journal (recent polls: 0 scans; old cursor: 1 scan) and a paused-writer concurrency test. managed/test: 64 passed; managed/scalafmtCheckAll and git diff --check passed.
